Good questions. Honest answers.

Something else on your mind? Talk to the team.

What is Clara?

An AI marketing team for founders and product teams. Start in chat or with a Play to create articles, social posts, and campaigns in your brand voice. Workflows make the process repeatable; agents take on ongoing marketing roles, with the level of autonomy you choose.

Who is it for?

Founders, product marketers, and small teams who need to explain what they’re building, especially when the story lives across product docs, technical material, and release notes.

Can I review content before it goes out?

Yes. Assistant and Co-pilot ask before external or irreversible actions such as publishing. Autopilot can publish automatically, and you can keep approval for specific actions, channels, products, or agents. Publishing needs the right connections and permissions.

Does Clara need to know my product first?

Good context makes better drafts. Add product docs, repositories, websites, or files, then define your brand voice and audience. You should still check the finished content.

Are these real product screenshots?

Yes. The product tour shows real screenshots from the running Clara app, in a demo workspace. The illustrations and the example week use Fieldnotes, a fictional product; they don’t generate or publish anything.

How can I try Clara? What does it cost?

We’re preparing Clara for early access. Tell us about your product and we’ll talk about availability. Pricing and launch dates haven’t been announced yet.

You build the product. Clara helps tell its story.
